fields.summary: VA proposes a sole-source extension of the current CCN Region 1 medical and dental network IDIQ contract for up to one year (October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2027) while competitive CCN-NG follow-on awards are delayed. The agency says unusual and compelling urgency applies because a lapse in Veteran care would occur without an interim action.
fields.summary_quote: These delays create a significant risk of a lapse in services. Without a readily available interim action, the agency would be unable to ensure the uninterrupted delivery of critical healthcare services to our Veterans.
fields.period_of_performance: up to one year, October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2027
fields.period_quote: This action will allow the current contractor to continue meeting the agency’s mission requirements for up to one (1) year, covering performance from October 1, 2026, through September 30, 2027
